description: Runs a saved workflow by workflow_id or name and returns its extracted data (it waits by default). Inputs go as top-level fields or under `inputs`; function_name runs one function of a multi-function API (with the sign-in it needs). max_age reuses a recent result at no cost. A write function previews with mutation_mode='dry_run'. Runs sign in as the workflow's persona or persona_id; no password is ever passed. Venue, network, files and output shape: writ_help('writ_run_workflow').

execution_target.description: cloud | auto | local (the user's own desktop app).

function_name.description: One function of a multi-function workflow.

max_age.description: Reuse a result younger than this many seconds (free). 0 = fresh.

workflow_id.description: A number, or 'local:<id>' (a workflow on the user's desktop).

name: writ_run_workflow
title: Run a saved workflow
